last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: Ask-Machine Week WON AND CLOSED Fri 07-24. Fri 07-24 was the biggest day the system has had, and ANDREW BROUGHT THE MATERIAL. He walked in with two words overheard off HIS WIFE AND HER SISTER talking to each other — full speed, unaimed at him — and asked to keep them: prachanai and kitta. First real-world catch evidence ever. Ran as a meta/lore day on his own words and it produced TEN COLD FIRES: kitta (akka-kitta ketten, novel), ketkuren (the present/future toggle, a listed gap), then the leaving-scene in one unbroken breath — avasaram irukku, station-kku poganum, keys en-kitta kudunga (kudunga victory lap + kitta bolted on). BOTH 07-22 STRAGGLERS CLOSED. Then, within the hour of being given the standing catch order, he came back with FIVE more stolen fragments: vandhuduchu, pannala, adhuku, and two I could not safely call (wande, velam — asked him for the surrounding sentence, still unanswered, chase these). That yielded frame:negative-la, seeded and FIRED COLD same session (saapidala, unaided) — the machine under puriyala/mudiyala he had been carrying as separate chunks. He also reconstructed the formal saapidavillai from the spoken form by instinct. Taught this session: kel = ask AND hear with kitta as the switch; en/un as the lying-down stems (enakku/enga/unakku); the vanishing object, which HE found himself; -ren = NOW + I, and the person-swap poren/porom/poranga; -la is -illai squashed; kashtam = hardship not just difficulty. LAST BEAT: asked for 'tamil kashtama irukku', got bare 'tamil kashtam' — a legal copula-drop sentence, so not a miss, but frame:adverb-aa did NOT fire and is still cold-pending. Hook it to suvaiya irukku / nallarukku, which he already owns — that is the next easy engine. TESTIMONY, twice, unprompted: 'overwhelms me a bit and also makes me feel like I am actually making progress — my theory of limited lemmas and picking up context is starting to pay off', and the big one: 'it feels more intuitive straight in tamil and not thinking about how the sentence is translated — not cumbersome natively but challenging to translate.' The deer-in-headlights antidote in his own words. KEEP DENSITY LOW, LORE HIGH — the meta thread produced ten cold fires; volume did not. His last reply was two words and a full stop: he was done, and was let go. FIELD MISSION 07-24: 'en-kitta kudunga' at the dinner table tonight (guaranteed slot). STANDING CATCH ORDER (renewable, proved itself in under an hour): bring back one word overheard from the sisters. NEXT CAMPAIGN drafted in profile.md — The Overhear Week, catch axis 0/12 — PITCHED, NOT YET AGREED; he adjusts or replaces it at the next open. -aam watch still open at 3 misses.
